title: fix(app-shell): the permission set's Add user picker shows each person's email beside their name
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgDFH4S5pR1C8YvYCWWsZfXx)_

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么：设置 › 权限集 › 已分配用户 › 添加用户 的选人框，原来只有姓名一列，现在多一列邮箱。
- 为什么改：同名的两个人在选人框里分不出来，授予权限集前也没法确认账号；同页已分配的列表本来就显示邮箱。
- 风险与回滚：只改选人框的列与表头，授予写法、成员过滤、AI 席位上限提示都不变；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`AssignedUsersSection.tsx` 里 `RecordPickerDialog` 新增的 `objectSchema` 与 `columns` 两个属性；新测试 `AssignedUsersSection.pickerColumns-27433.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证：打开任一权限集 › 已分配用户 › 添加用户，预期选人框出现「姓名」「邮箱」两列；无权读 `sys_user.email` 的角色只看到姓名列。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #27433

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

On a Setup permission-set page, **Assigned users › Add user** opened `RecordPickerDialog` on `sys_user` with no `columns`, so the picker drew the name alone. It now passes, in the same shape as Position › Add holder (#27427):

- `columns` for `name` and `email`, headed from the section's own en/zh copy (`Name`/`Email`, `姓名`/`邮箱`) — no new `@object-ui/i18n` key, so `Clause-②: no`;
- `objectSchema` set to `sys_user` from the `useMetadata()` objects the section already holds — no new fetch;
- no permission check of its own: the picker's own `readableColumns` rule decides what is drawn.

Files: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/AssignedUsersSection.tsx`, one new test beside it, `.changeset/27433-permission-set-user-picker-email.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell` + `@object-ui/console` patch, as #27427's).

## Tests

`AssignedUsersSection.pickerColumns-27433.test.tsx`, against the real `RecordPickerDialog` (not a stub) and a real `PermissionProvider`:

- the picker draws a Name column and an Email column (cells read by `data-lookup-cell`);
- CONTROL: the picker offers the active organization's members only (a `sys_user` in another organization is not drawn);
- CONTROL: choosing a person still writes `sys_user_permission_set` `{ user_id, permission_set }` by name;
- CONTROL: an AI-seat cap refusal from the grant write still shows inline;
- CONTROL: under a policy that denies `sys_user.email` (grant writes allowed), only the name column is drawn and no email text appears in the dialog.

Ablation (one-shot, not kept): `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` deleted the `columns` prop (anchor 1 → 0, blob `6e003bf1` → `495a0d0e`) → the column test went red (1 failed / 4 passed), the four CONTROLs stayed green; restored to blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. The later commit `3b0005b0` only changes the schema cast's type.

## Acceptance notes

- Every acceptance line of #27433 is pinned by a test above.
- The seat-cap test asserts the inline sentence by a regex on its leading words only (the card names the inline refusal as the CONTROL; the copy is the section's own).
- No out-of-scope findings.

## Verification

All on head `3b0005b0` (base `968cacfd`), locally:
